recent_lessons.lesson: Mandate enforcement must be MECHANICAL, not advisory. Writing a mandate document and not wiring pre-trade gates means new violations (e.g., MDT 24% entry) keep firing under the old strategy logic. The gate has to live in the runner.

Generational wealth requires 8% single-name cap + 60-70% vault floor + zero margin. Concentration on margin is the failure mode generational wealth must not have. A 50% loss requires a 100% gain to recover.

strategies.name: Construct Synthesis Signal
strategies.hypothesis: The Lens daily intelligence brief synthesizes ~5 patterns per day from institutional research (HBR, MIT Sloan, Wharton, Stratechery, NBER, Fed). When ≥3 institutions converge on the same theme in one week, that's a high-conviction directional signal usable for sector/factor allocation. Bobby's Lens is the moat — no other quant uses this input.
strategies.open_source_inspiration: Bobby's own Lens daily-scan output (Atlas/lens-briefs/) — a proprietary intelligence corpus built from open institutional sources.
strategies.cross_agent_inputs: Lens (signal generator), Architect (allocation), Keystone (regime context), Helm (agent-economy theme detection).
